subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

ASSIST
solution:
The correct answer is: **Facilitate**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Assist means to take action to help someone or support something.

 
 
• Example - *Volunteers **assisted **in searching for the boy.*
 
 
 
• *​*Marked option **Facilitate **means to make easier: help bring about.
 
 
• Example - *Careful planning **facilitates **any kind of work.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Assist' and '**Facilitate**' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Acquire **means to get or obtain something.
 
• **Restrict **means to put a limit on somebody/something.
 
• **Injure **means to harm or hurt yourself or somebody else physically, especially in an accident.
